Appointments & C., by the President
My No.: PS/CSA/00/1/1/1/IX.

It is hereby notified that the Honourable President, in terms of Article 44(2) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, has appointed the following Ministers with effect from November 18, 2024.
